popupFilter.description: Popup: the Filter button next to the search box while the list shows everything, and the name of its menu (vaults and kinds of item).

popupFilterShow.description: Popup, Filter menu: heading of the section that picks the kind of item shown (All, Logins, 2FA, ...).

popupUnpinNamed.description: Popup, a pinned vault's row in the Filter menu or the vault switcher: its pin button takes the pin off. $VAULT$ is the vault's name.

popupVaultPinned.description: Popup: what a screen reader hears after a pinned vault's name in a vault list.

popupTypeFilter.description: Popup, Filter menu: what a screen reader hears for its Show section, which narrows the list to one kind of item.

popupTypeAll.description: Popup, type filter chip: every kind of item.

popupTypeLogins.description: Popup, type filter chip: only logins (not cards or addresses).

popupTypeCards.description: Popup, type filter chip: only payment cards.

popupTypeAddresses.description: Popup, type filter chip: only addresses (identities).

popupTypeFavorites.description: Popup, type filter chip: only items marked as favorites (logins, cards, addresses, notes).

popupTypeNotes.description: Popup, type filter chip: only secure notes.

popupSecureNotes.description: Popup: heading of the list of secure notes (the Notes and Favorites filters).

popupSecureNote.description: Popup: the line under a secure note's title in the list.

popupShowNote.description: Popup: tooltip of a secure note's row (opens the note and shows its text).

popupShowNoteOf.description: Popup: accessible name of a secure note's row (opens the note).

popupCopyNote.description: Popup: button that copies the text of a secure note.

popupCopyNoteOf.description: Popup: accessible name of the copy button of a secure note's row.

popupCopiedNote.description: Notice after copying a secure note's text.

popupCopiedNoteClears.description: Notice after copying a secure note's text; the clipboard is cleared after 45 seconds.

popupNoteEmpty.description: Popup: a secure note without text (in its viewer, or after Copy).

popupNoteText.description: Popup: accessible name of a secure note's text in its viewer.

popupNoFilterMatches.message: Tidak ada yang sejenis di sini.
popupNoFilterMatches.description: Popup: empty state when the type filter chosen leaves nothing to show.
